Name: Page Header Purpose
Description: 展示页面的标题、返回导航、操作按钮等信息

Name: Page Header Position
Description: 页头位于页面内容区域的最顶部

Name: Page Header Height
Description: 页头高度根据内容自适应

Name: Back Button Show
Description: 页头左侧显示返回按钮

Name: Back Button Icon
Description: 返回按钮使用左箭头图标

Name: SubTitle Divider
Description: 标题与副标题之间竖线分隔

Name: Primary Button Padding
Description: 主操作按钮左右内边距16px

Name: Primary Button Hover
Description: 主操作按钮悬停深蓝色

Name: Default Button Hover Border
Description: 默认按钮悬停蓝色边框

Name: Default Button Hover Color
Description: 默认按钮悬停蓝色文字

Name: Dropdown Trigger
Description: 更多操作点击触发下拉

Name: Breadcrumb Show
Description: 页头上方显示面包屑导航

Name: Breadcrumb Separator Margin
Description: 面包屑分隔符左右间距8px

Name: Breadcrumb Home Icon
Description: 面包屑首页使用房子图标

Name: Description Show
Description: 页头下方显示描述信息

Name: Meta Margin Top
Description: 元信息与上方内容间距12px

Name: Meta Label Width
Description: 元信息标签宽度自适应

Name: Meta Colon
Description: 元信息标签后中文冒号

Name: Tabs Item Active Border
Description: 标签项激活底部蓝色边框

Name: Tabs Margin Top
Description: 标签页与上方内容间距16px

Name: Left Section Flex
Description: 左侧区域占据剩余空间

Name: Right Section Flex
Description: 右侧区域宽度自适应内容

Name: Variant Default
Description: 标准页头包含返回/标题/操作

Name: Variant Simple
Description: 仅包含标题和操作按钮

Name: Variant Complex
Description: 包含头像/标签/描述/元信息/标签页

Name: Variant With Breadcrumb
Description: 页头上方带面包屑导航

Name: Variant With Tabs
Description: 页头底部带标签页切换

Name: Mobile Actions Stack
Description: 移动端操作按钮垂直堆叠

Name: Mobile Meta Stack
Description: 移动端元信息垂直堆叠

Name: Extra Content Gap
Description: 额外内容与操作按钮间距16px

Name: Footer Show
Description: 页头底部页脚默认不显示
